info.name: Fleet Management API
info.description:
Complete API collection for Fleet Management System with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).

## Base URL
`http://localhost:8080/api/v1`

## User Roles & Permissions

### Owner (Full Access)
- ✅ Create, Read, Update, Delete all resources
- ✅ Manage team members (Managers, Supervisors)
- ✅ Delete drivers, vehicles, trips, documents

### Manager (Operational Access)
- ✅ Create, Read, Update drivers, vehicles, trips, documents
- ✅ Register vehicles, upload documents
- ❌ Delete resources (only Owner)
- ❌ Manage team members

### Supervisor (View & Track Access)
- ✅ View all resources (own organization only)
- ✅ Track vehicle locations
- ✅ Register vehicles
- ❌ Create/modify drivers, trips
- ❌ Upload/delete documents

## Data Isolation
- All data is automatically filtered by organization (owner_id)
- Manager/Supervisor can only see their owner's data

## API Routes Summary

**Authentication (Public)**
- POST /auth/signup - Register new owner
- POST /auth/login - Login
- POST /auth/forgot-password - Request password reset
- POST /auth/reset-password - Reset password

**Profile (All Roles)**
- GET /profile - Get profile
- PUT /profile - Update profile
- POST /profile/change-password - Change password

**Dashboard (Role-based)**
- GET /dashboard/owner - Owner dashboard
- GET /dashboard/manager - Manager dashboard
- GET /dashboard/supervisor - Supervisor dashboard

**Team Management (Owner Only)**
- POST /team/members - Create team member
- GET /team/members - List team members
- GET /team/members/:id - Get team member
- PUT /team/members/:id - Update team member
- DELETE /team/members/:id - Delete team member

**Vehicles**
- POST /vehicles - Register vehicle
- POST /vehicles/with-documents - Register with documents
- GET /vehicles - List vehicles
- GET /vehicles/:id - Get vehicle
- PUT /vehicles/:id - Update vehicle (Owner/Manager)
- PATCH /vehicles/:id/state - Update state (Owner/Manager)
- DELETE /vehicles/:id - Delete vehicle (Owner only)
- POST /vehicles/:id/documents - Upload document
- POST /vehicles/:id/documents/bulk - Bulk upload
- GET /vehicles/:id/documents - Get documents
- GET /vehicles/:id/location - Get current location
- GET /vehicles/:id/location/history - Get location history

**Documents**
- GET /documents/types - Get document types
- GET /documents/expiring - Get expiring documents
- GET /documents/expired - Get expired documents
- GET /documents/status/:status - Get by status
- GET /documents/:id - Get document
- GET /documents/:id/download - Download document
- PUT /documents/:id - Update document (Owner/Manager)
- POST /documents/:id/verify - Verify document (Owner/Manager)
- DELETE /documents/:id - Delete document (Owner only)

**Trips**
- POST /trips - Create trip (Owner/Manager)
- GET /trips - List trips
- GET /trips/:id - Get trip
- PUT /trips/:id - Update trip (Owner/Manager)
- PATCH /trips/:id/state - Update state (Owner/Manager)
- PATCH /trips/:id/location - Update location (All roles)
- DELETE /trips/:id - Delete trip (Owner only)
- GET /trips/:id/stops - Get stops
- POST /trips/:id/stops - Add stop (Owner/Manager)
- PUT /trips/:id/stops/:stop_id - Update stop (Owner/Manager)
- PATCH /trips/:id/stops/:stop_id/complete - Mark complete (All roles)
- DELETE /trips/:id/stops/:stop_id - Delete stop (Owner/Manager)

**Drivers**
- POST /drivers - Create driver (Owner/Manager)
- GET /drivers - List drivers
- GET /drivers/available - Get available drivers
- GET /drivers/:id - Get driver
- PUT /drivers/:id - Update driver (Owner/Manager)
- PATCH /drivers/:id/status - Update status (Owner/Manager)
- PATCH /drivers/:id/toggle-active - Toggle active (Owner/Manager)
- DELETE /drivers/:id - Delete driver (Owner only)

**Locations**
- POST /locations/track - Track location
- POST /locations/track/bulk - Bulk track
- GET /locations/current - Get all current locations

- alert_docs: Documents needing attention (expired, expiring soon, required but not uploaded)
- other_documents: Any additional documents

request.description:
Get combined data for all tabs in one API call.

**Access:** All roles

**Use Case:** Initial load of VehicleDetailScreen to fetch all tab data at once, reducing API calls.

**Returns:**
- vehicle: Basic info with state labels
- assigned_driver: Driver details if assigned
- current_location: Latest GPS location
- stats: Trip statistics
- documents: Summary with alerts
- trips: Total count and recent 5 trips
- route: Active trip status with stops count

item.name: Documents
item.description:
Vehicle document management endpoints.

**RBAC Permissions:**
- Upload/Update/Verify: Owner, Manager
- View/Download: All roles
- Delete: Owner only

**Document Tags:**
- RC (Registration Certificate)
- INS (Insurance)
- PUC (PUC Certificate)
- FC (Fitness Certificate)
- RT (Road Tax)
- PERMIT (Permit)
- OTHER (Other)

formdata.description: Type (Tag): registration_certificate (RC), insurance (INS), puc_certificate (PUC), fitness_certificate (FC), road_tax (RT), permit (PERMIT), other (OTHER)
Optional - Unique document number (policy number, certificate number, etc.)
Optional - Date when document was issued (RFC3339 format)
Optional - Date when document expires (RFC3339 format)
Optional - Authority that issued the document (e.g., RTO, Insurance Company)

request.description:
Upload a document for a vehicle.

**Access:** Owner, Manager only

❌ Supervisors will receive 403 Forbidden

**Document Types and Tags:**
- registration_certificate → RC
- insurance → INS
- puc_certificate → PUC
- fitness_certificate → FC
- road_tax → RT
- permit → PERMIT
- other → OTHER

**New Fields:**
- document_number: Unique identifier (e.g., policy number)
- issue_date: When the document was issued
- expiry_date: When the document expires
- issuing_authority: Who issued the document
- remarks: Additional notes

formdata.description: Registration Certificate file [Tag: RC] (PDF, JPEG, PNG - max 10MB)
Insurance policy file [Tag: INS] (PDF, JPEG, PNG - max 10MB)
PUC Certificate file [Tag: PUC] (PDF, JPEG, PNG - max 10MB)
Fitness Certificate file [Tag: FC] (PDF, JPEG, PNG - max 10MB)
Road Tax receipt file [Tag: RT] (PDF, JPEG, PNG - max 10MB)
Permit file [Tag: PERMIT] (PDF, JPEG, PNG - max 10MB)

item.name: Real-Time Location Tracking
item.description:
Real-time location tracking using MQTT (Vehicle → Server) and WebSocket (Server → Mobile Apps).

## Architecture
- **MQTT**: Vehicles publish GPS location every 1-2 seconds
- **WebSocket**: Server broadcasts location updates to connected mobile apps
- **Database**: Location data stored in Supabase PostgreSQL

## Vehicle Identification
- Uses `registration_number` (e.g., 'MH12AB1234') instead of vehicle_id
- Automatically resolves vehicle_id and owner_id

## MQTT Topics
- `fleet/vehicle/{registration_number}/location` - Vehicle location updates
- `fleet/trip/{trip_id}/location` - Trip-specific tracking

## WebSocket
- Connect to: `ws://localhost:8080/ws` (requires JWT token)


Submit a single location update via REST API.

**Note:** For high-frequency tracking (1-2 seconds), use MQTT instead of REST API.

**Request Body:**

|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| registration_number | string | ✅ | Vehicle registration number (e.g., 'MH12AB1234') |
| lat | float64 | ✅ | Latitude (-90 to 90) |

**Note:** `vehicle_id` and `owner_id` are automatically resolved from `registration_number`.

item.name: MQTT Configuration (Reference)
item.description:
Reference information for MQTT integration. These are not REST endpoints - use an MQTT client to connect.

## MQTT Broker
- **Local**: `tcp://localhost:1883`
- **Dashboard**: http://localhost:18083 (admin/public)

## Start MQTT Broker
```bash
docker run -d --name emqx -p 1883:1883 -p 18083:18083 emqx/emqx:5.3.0
```

request.description:
## MQTT Topic Format

**Vehicle Location (using registration number):**
```
fleet/vehicle/{registration_number}/location
```
Example: `fleet/vehicle/MH12AB1234/location`

**Trip Location:**
```
fleet/trip/{trip_id}/location
```

## Message Payload (JSON)

```json
{
  "registration_number": "MH12AB1234",
  "lat": 19.0760,
  "lng": 72.8777,
  "speed": 45.5,
  "ts": 1703500800000
}
```

## Field Descriptions

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| registration_number | string | ✅ | Vehicle registration (e.g., 'MH12AB1234') |
| lat | float64 | ✅ | Latitude (-90 to 90) |
| lng | float64 | ✅ | Longitude (-180 to 180) |
| speed | float64 | ✅ | Speed in km/h |
| ts | int64 | ✅ | Unix timestamp (milliseconds) |
| heading | float64 | ❌ | Direction (0-360°) |
| accuracy | float64 | ❌ | GPS accuracy in meters |
| trip_id | int64 | ❌ | Active trip ID |
| driver_id | int64 | ❌ | Driver ID |
| owner_id | int64 | ❌ | Organization ID (auto-resolved) |
| bat | int | ❌ | Battery level (0-100) |
| provider | string | ❌ | Location provider (gps/network) |

**Note:** `vehicle_id` and `owner_id` are automatically resolved from `registration_number`.

## WebSocket Connection

**URL:** `ws://localhost:8080/ws`

**Authentication:** JWT token in Authorization header

```javascript
const ws = new WebSocket('ws://localhost:8080/ws', [], {
  headers: {
    'Authorization': 'Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN'
  }
});
```

## Received Message Format

```json
{
  "type": "location_update",
  "registration_number": "MH12AB1234",
  "vehicle_id": 123,
  "trip_id": 456,
  "driver_id": 789,
  "lat": 19.0760,
  "lng": 72.8777,
  "speed": 45.5,
  "heading": 180.0,
  "ts": 1703500800000
}
```

## Notes
- Messages are only sent for vehicles in your organization
- Connection auto-pings every 30 seconds
- Reconnect automatically on disconnect
